ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black surface estimated at 85% coverage, with 15% high-intensity white pixels localized at the distal tips and as scattered circular clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Visible high-intensity white blocks at both lateral tips; high-contrast white circular annuli (rings) scattered across the mid-to-distal regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with an approximate 55-degree angle relative to the medial axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with frequent low-amplitude serrations and one significant large-scale semi-circular notch on the upper right lobe margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the superior margins of both lobes tapering to sharp, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clustered high-contrast white circular scars (barnacle attachment points) distributed extensively across the central and outer fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct light-colored linear mark oriented diagonally on the upper portion of the left fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregular traumatic notch located on the superior trailing edge of the right fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-contrast water spray/droplets along the periphery of the trailing edge.
